نزخ (form I)
# نَزُخُّ (nazuḵḵu) /na.zux.xu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of زَخَّ (zaḵḵa)
# نَزُخَّ (nazuḵḵa) /na.zux.xa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of زَخَّ (zaḵḵa)
# نَزُخِّ (nazuḵḵi) /na.zux.xi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of زَخَّ (zaḵḵa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
